apiAccess.title: API Access
apiAccess.description: Personal API key for calling the {appName} API from n8n, Zapier, or your own scripts — create leads, start campaigns, dial calls.
apiAccess.copyNow: Copy your API key now — it won't be shown again.
apiAccess.usageHint: Send the key in an X-API-Key header with any request. Full endpoint list below.
apiAccess.referenceIntro: Base URL {baseUrl} — every endpoint accepts X-API-Key. Responses are {shape} JSON. For receiving events (lead created, call completed, …) use the Webhooks tab or the n8n integration instead.

n8n.description: Stream every platform event into n8n workflows and automate with 400+ apps — CRMs, sheets, email, Slack, and more.
n8n.step1: 1. In your n8n workflow, add a Webhook node with method POST (or import a template below — it already has one).
n8n.step2: 2. Copy the node's Production URL and activate the workflow — or use the Test URL while building.
n8n.step3: 3. Paste the URL here and connect. Events arrive as JSON: {shape}.
n8n.templatesHint: Download and import into n8n (Workflow menu → Import from File), then follow the sticky note inside each one.
n8n.newToN8n: New to n8n? It's a free, self-hostable automation tool —

hubspot.description: Push every new lead into HubSpot as a contact, matched by phone number — no duplicates.
hubspot.notConfigured: HubSpot integration is not configured on this server. Ask the administrator to set
hubspot.syncLeadsHint: Every lead created in {appName} (manual, bulk import, or campaign) is upserted as a HubSpot contact, matched by phone.
hubspot.serviceKeyHint: Create one in HubSpot under Settings → Integrations → Service keys (or Development → Keys → Service keys) with the crm.objects.contacts.read and crm.objects.contacts.write scopes, then paste it here.
hubspot.serviceKeyDocs: How to create a service key
hubspot.connectedVia: Connected with a service key ending in {last4}
hubspot.connectedViaOAuth: Connected with the legacy OAuth app
hubspot.legacyOAuthHint: HubSpot stopped allowing new public apps on 23 June 2026. This option only works for installs that registered an app before then — everyone else should use a service key.

whatsapp.description: Get real-time notifications on your WhatsApp — lead created, call completed, appointment booked, and more. Powered by the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API.
whatsapp.step1: 1. Create a free app with the WhatsApp product at
whatsapp.step2: 2. Open WhatsApp > API Setup and copy the access token and Phone Number ID.
whatsapp.step3: 3. Enter your own WhatsApp number below to receive the alerts (add it as a recipient in API Setup when using Meta's test number).
whatsapp.tokenHint: Use a permanent token (System User) so notifications don't stop after 24 hours.
whatsapp.sessionWarning: WhatsApp only delivers these alerts inside a 24-hour session. Send any message from your WhatsApp to {number} to open (and keep open) the delivery window.
whatsapp.remindersHint: Send a WhatsApp reminder to the client's number before their appointment starts.
whatsapp.templateSetupTitle: One-time setup: create the message template
whatsapp.templateSetupIntro: Reminders are business-initiated, so Meta requires a pre-approved template. In
whatsapp.templateSetupOutro: create a Utility template (e.g. appointment_reminder) with this body:
whatsapp.templateBody: Hi {v1}, this is a friendly reminder about your appointment on {v2} at {v3}. We look forward to speaking with you!
whatsapp.templateVars: We fill {v1} = client name, {v2} = date, {v3} = time. Wording is up to you, but keep exactly these 3 variables. Approval usually takes a few minutes.
whatsapp.templateLanguageHint: Code from the template, e.g. en, en_US, ar.

page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: Configure your account, API credentials, and subscription.

credentials.title: Twilio & AI Credentials
credentials.description: These keys are required to initiate phone calls and power the AI agent.
credentials.deepgramHint: Powers speech recognition — and the low-latency "Deepgram Voice Agent" engine selectable per agent (which also uses your ElevenLabs voice but needs no OpenRouter key).
credentials.sarvamHint: Powers the self-contained "Sarvam AI" engine for Indian languages (speech, reasoning and voice all on Sarvam). Selectable per agent — needs no other keys.
credentials.geminiHint: Powers the "Gemini Live" engine — one Google model hears, thinks and speaks, in 97 languages. Selectable per agent on SIP numbers — needs no other keys.

webhooks.enableHint: Toggle to start sending events to your URL.

webhooks.signingSecretHint: Secures your webhook by signing the payload with HMAC-SHA256.

emailNotifications.recipientEmailHint: Address where notifications will be sent.
